description: This file declares interfaces and functions related to the QUIC protocol implementation within cURL, focusing on HTTP/3 support, including versioning, logging, connection checks, and creation functions.

methods.name: Curl_quic_ver
methods.description: Outputs the version of the QUIC implementation.

methods.name: Curl_qlogdir
methods.description: Sets or retrieves the directory for QUIC logs.

methods.name: Curl_cf_quic_create
methods.description: Creates a new QUIC connection filter.

methods.name: Curl_conn_is_http3
methods.description: Checks whether the current connection uses HTTP/3.

methods.name: Curl_conn_may_http3
methods.description: Determines if the connection might support HTTP/3.
